help.stdout:
usage: gnd exp author-expectation [-h] --case CASE_ID --output-id OUTPUT_ID
                                  --candidate-path CANDIDATE_PATH --from
                                  SOURCE [--media-type MEDIA_TYPE]
                                  [--encoding ENCODING]
                                  directory

Author one answer-free exact-bytes expectation in <DIR>/session.contract.json.
--from must be an experiment-relative regular file (an absolute path is
accepted only when it remains inside DIR). The source is read through
descriptor-anchored, no-follow traversal and the 10 MiB session-input cap, the
updated contract is production-validated before publication, the source is
deleted, and every regular file under the experiment root is scanned for equal
bytes. The contract entry contains sha256, output_id, candidate_path,
comparison, media_type, and encoding, but no path or size_bytes. Exits 0 only
after the published contract loads and no answer copy remains; 3 when the
spec, contract, case, output, source, or answer-copy state is refused; 64 on
usage errors; 66 when SPEC.md is missing; 74 on refused or failed path/I/O.

positional arguments:
  directory             the data-driven experiment directory

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --case CASE_ID        case_id to update
  --output-id OUTPUT_ID
                        expected output id to insert or replace
  --candidate-path CANDIDATE_PATH
                        output path relative to candidate/
  --from SOURCE         produced answer file inside the experiment root
  --media-type MEDIA_TYPE
                        declared media type (default: application/json)
  --encoding ENCODING   declared encoding (default: utf-8)
